src="https://zh.simeononsecurity.com/opencode-clients-server-provider.webp" alt="连接到代理服务器、仓库文件和独立推理服务的终端与桌面客户端"loading="lazy" fetchpriority="low" itemprop="contentUrl" /> <figcaption align="center" style="text-align: center; margin: 0 auto;" itemprop="caption description"> <p>分别检查代理服务器和推理提供商</p> </figcaption> </figure> </center> <h2 id="终端交互与自动化"> <a href="#%e7%bb%88%e7%ab%af%e4%ba%a4%e4%ba%92%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e5%8a%a8%e5%8c%96" title="终端交互与自动化">终端交互与自动化</a> <a href="#%e7%bb%88%e7%ab%af%e4%ba%a4%e4%ba%92%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e5%8a%a8%e5%8c%96" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="终端交互与自动化">#</a> </h2> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span style="display:flex;"><span>opencode </span></span></code></pre></div><p><strong>默认命令会打开终端 UI。</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="CLI 参考"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/"> <a href="https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >CLI 参考</a> </span> 也记录了程序化命令。在目标仓库中开始，并在请求修改前确认所选代理和模型。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span style="display:flex;"><span>opencode run <span style="color:#e6db74">"Identify this project's test command. Do not modify files."</span> </span></span></code></pre></div><p><strong>使用 <code>opencode run</code> 发送有边界的非交互请求。</strong> 单独确定适当的权限策略。要求不修改文件可以提供方向，但不会强制文件系统隔离。</p> <p><strong>当 shell 组合很重要时，选择这种工作流。</strong> 可重复的包装器应记录请求、退出状态、相关输出和已修改文件。明确处理失败。空 diff 和成功消息与经过验证的修复需要不同的解释。</p> <h2 id="desktop-设置与兼容性"> <a href="#desktop-%e8%ae%be%e7%bd%ae%e4%b8%8e%e5%85%bc%e5%ae%b9%e6%80%a7" title="Desktop 设置与兼容性">Desktop 设置与兼容性</a> <a href="#desktop-%e8%ae%be%e7%bd%ae%e4%b8%8e%e5%85%bc%e5%ae%b9%e6%80%a7" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="Desktop 设置与兼容性">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>为目标版本使用官方下载页面。</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="OpenCode 下载页面"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://opencode.ai/download"> <a href="https://opencode.ai/download" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >OpenCode 下载页面</a> </span> 列出终端和桌面软件包。在本次检查中，下载页面宣传 v2 终端软件包，而通用文档还包含较旧的安装示例。记录客户端和后端的确切版本，不要混用不同发布轨道的说明。</p> <p><strong>用一个小型真实任务评估桌面交互。</strong> 打开项目，确认服务器，提交有边界的请求，检查已修改文件，并请求修正。评估理解代理操作所需的工作量。不要假设图形客户端完全替代编辑器和调试器。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Desktop 试用</th> <th>预期证据</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>项目选择</strong></td> <td>代理识别目标仓库</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>模型选择</strong></td> <td>提供商和模型与试用记录一致</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>命令执行</strong></td> <td>所需运行时和测试可用</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>变更检查</strong></td> <td>容易找到并审查完整补丁</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>重启</strong></td> <td>目标项目和会话仍可识别</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h2 id="配置与模型访问"> <a href="#%e9%85%8d%e7%bd%ae%e4%b8%8e%e6%a8%a1%e5%9e%8b%e8%ae%bf%e9%97%ae" title="配置与模型访问">配置与模型访问</a> <a href="#%e9%85%8d%e7%bd%ae%e4%b8%8e%e6%a8%a1%e5%9e%8b%e8%ae%bf%e9%97%ae" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="配置与模型访问">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>OpenCode 会合并多个位置的配置。</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="配置参考"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://opencode.ai/docs/config/"> <a href="https://opencode.ai/docs/config/" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >配置参考</a> </span> 解释优先级和无冲突设置的保留方式。比较有效的模型、代理和权限，而不只是一个项目文件。</p> <p><strong>提供商访问属于执行设置。</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="提供商指南"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://opencode.ai/docs/providers/"> <a href="https://opencode.ai/docs/providers/" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >提供商指南</a> </span> 介绍支持的服务和兼容的 endpoints。凭据、endpoint 可达性和模型工具支持都很重要。在其他位置运行的服务器需要自己有效访问提供商和仓库。</p> <p><strong>客户端不会决定总推理成本。</strong> 用相同模型和任务比较计费使用量。包括由配置错误导致的重复运行。使用本地推理时，记录系统内存、模型格式、上下文大小和运行时设置。不要把桌面下载描述成托管计算的免费替代品。</p> <h2 id="会话与安全切换"> <a href="#%e4%bc%9a%e8%af%9d%e4%b8%8e%e5%ae%89%e5%85%a8%e5%88%87%e6%8d%a2" title="会话与安全切换">会话与安全切换</a> <a href="#%e4%bc%9a%e8%af%9d%e4%b8%8e%e5%ae%89%e5%85%a8%e5%88%87%e6%8d%a2" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="会话与安全切换">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>验证连续性，不要假设连续性。</strong> 切换客户端前记录活动项目和会话。检查目标是否连接到预期服务器并显示预期历史记录。开始新会话时，提供包含目标、已完成工作和剩余检查的简要交接。</p> <p><strong>避免对同一 checkout 进行并发编辑。</strong> 两个计划不同的对话如果指向同一目录，就会共享文件。独立实验使用不同的 worktree 或 checkout。合并变更前先审查。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Handover record </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Goal: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Current branch and working directory: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Files changed: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Checks already completed: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Known failures: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Next approved action: </span></span></code></pre></div><p><strong>这份记录让交接可检查。</strong> 它也能帮助区分界面问题、缺少指令和环境不匹配。不要把凭据放入记录。</p> <h2 id="服务器访问与权限"> <a href="#%e6%9c%8d%e5%8a%a1%e5%99%a8%e8%ae%bf%e9%97%ae%e4%b8%8e%e6%9d%83%e9%99%90" title="服务器访问与权限">服务器访问与权限</a> <a href="#%e6%9c%8d%e5%8a%a1%e5%99%a8%e8%ae%bf%e9%97%ae%e4%b8%8e%e6%9d%83%e9%99%90" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="服务器访问与权限">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>将代理服务器视为执行服务。</strong> 服务器文档介绍通过 <code>OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD</code> 进行可选身份验证。在跨设备连接前，有意配置访问权限。可访问的代理服务器不等于无害的静态网站。</p> <p><strong>单独审查工具权限。</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="权限指南"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://opencode.ai/docs/permissions/"> <a href="https://opencode.ai/docs/permissions/" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >权限指南</a> </span> 定义 allow、ask 和 deny 行为。在界面试用期间应用相同策略。检查有效规则前，不要因为客户端提示更少就认为它更安全或更有能力。</p> <p><strong>从无害的策略测试开始。</strong> 在一次性项目中请求允许的文件检查和禁止的编辑。验证观察到的行为，再进行有边界的实施。这样可以测试权限假设。</p> <h2 id="故障排除与选择"> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e9%99%a4%e4%b8%8e%e9%80%89%e6%8b%a9" title="故障排除与选择">故障排除与选择</a> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e9%99%a4%e4%b8%8e%e9%80%89%e6%8b%a9" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="故障排除与选择">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>症状</th> <th>首先检查</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>Desktop 连接失败</strong></td> <td>所选服务器和本地 sidecar 状态</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>一个客户端缺少模型</strong></td> <td>服务器版本、提供商访问和配置</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>测试结果不同</strong></td> <td>项目目录和运行时环境</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>缺少对话</strong></td> <td>服务器和会话身份</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>加载插件前正常</strong></td> <td>插件配置和版本兼容性</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p><strong>如果脚本请求和 shell 上下文让工作更简单，就选择终端。</strong> <strong>如果图形化项目导航改善监督，就选择 Desktop。</strong> 将提供商和策略决定与这个偏好分开。</p> <p><strong>下一步：</strong> 在 <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="CLI 汇总"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/cli-coding-agents-comparison/"> <a href="/articles/cli-coding-agents-comparison/" rel="follow me" >CLI 汇总</a> </span> 中比较终端替代方案。有关本地推理要求，请阅读 <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="OpenCode 与 Strata 指南"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/strata-opencode-local-coding-agent-16gb/"> <a href="/articles/strata-opencode-local-coding-agent-16gb/" rel="follow me" >OpenCode 与 Strata 指南</a> </span> 。有关图形化替代方案，请使用 <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="GUI 汇总"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/gui-coding-agents-comparison/"> <a href="/articles/gui-coding-agents-comparison/" rel="follow me" >GUI 汇总</a> </span> 。</p> Read More at https://zh.simeononsecurity.com/

item.title: AI 代理偏差恢复与交接工作流
item.category: "人工智能" , "团队协作" , "软件工程"
item.description: 识别过时的来源和策略适配器，恢复中断的发布，并验证代理之间的独立交接。
item.content:encoded: <p> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="返回 AI 协作课程"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/ai-collaboration-course-start/"> <a href="/ai-collaboration-course-start/" rel="follow me" >返回 AI 协作课程</a> </span> </p> <p>**在任务开始前和发布中断后检查偏差。**在代码库或工作沙箱中比较来源版本、适配器版本和交付状态。完成一个工作轨道后执行此操作。这样可避免旧摘要被当成当前权威信息，并保留可审查的恢复历史。</p> <h2 id="要点"> <a href="#%e8%a6%81%e7%82%b9" title="要点">要点</a> <a href="#%e8%a6%81%e7%82%b9" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="要点">#</a> </h2> <ul> <li><strong>来源偏差</strong>不同于适配器偏差。</li> <li><strong>部分发布</strong>需要每个系统都有单独的台账。</li> <li><strong>恢复</strong>会保留历史和经过审查的变更。</li> <li><strong>交接</strong>要求另一位审查者独立读取当前来源。</li> </ul> <h2 id="开始之前"> <a href="#%e5%bc%80%e5%a7%8b%e4%b9%8b%e5%89%8d" title="开始之前">开始之前</a> <a href="#%e5%bc%80%e5%a7%8b%e4%b9%8b%e5%89%8d" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="开始之前">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>前提条件：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="GitHub 浏览器工作流"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/ai-collaboration-github-browser-workflow/"> <a href="/articles/ai-collaboration-github-browser-workflow/" rel="follow me" >GitHub 浏览器工作流</a> </span> 或 <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="混合发布工作流"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/ai-collaboration-confluence-jira-publication/"> <a href="/articles/ai-collaboration-confluence-jira-publication/" rel="follow me" >混合发布工作流</a> </span> 。**预计耗时：**60 至 90 分钟。**难度：**高级审查。</p> <p>**安全：**仅使用合成记录。恢复测试前暂停自动发布。本文不提供正在运行的删除服务。</p> <p>**读者成果：**完成状态清单、所有者决策、经过审查的修复，以及另一位审查者可依据当前来源重建的交接。完成练习不代表获得发布批准。</p> <h2 id="分类识别偏差"> <a href="#%e5%88%86%e7%b1%bb%e8%af%86%e5%88%ab%e5%81%8f%e5%b7%ae" title="分类识别偏差">分类识别偏差</a> <a href="#%e5%88%86%e7%b1%bb%e8%af%86%e5%88%ab%e5%81%8f%e5%b7%ae" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="分类识别偏差">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>偏差类型</th> <th>信号</th> <th>修复负责人</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>需求</strong></td> <td>来源与清单不同</td> <td>产品负责人</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>策略</strong></td> <td>适配器与 POL-01 不同</td> <td>策略负责人</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>实现</strong></td> <td>配置与意图矛盾</td> <td>维护者</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>运行手册</strong></td> <td>说明与已批准的行为矛盾</td> <td>运维负责人</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>访问</strong></td> <td>以前可读的来源现在被拒绝</td> <td>管理员，任务已停止</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>交付</strong></td> <td>台账未完成却标记为完成</td> <td>交付负责人</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**最新文本不一定是已批准的权威信息。**最近发生的未授权编辑需要调查，不能自动采用。复制值之前先确认状态和负责人。</p> <h2 id="执行预检"> <a href="#%e6%89%a7%e8%a1%8c%e9%a2%84%e6%a3%80" title="执行预检">执行预检</a> <a href="#%e6%89%a7%e8%a1%8c%e9%a2%84%e6%a3%80" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="执行预检">#</a> </h2> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read MAP-01 and capture its revision. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read POL-01 and compare active adapter versions. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read REQ-17 and RUN-04 from mapped homes. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read config.json at protected main. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read frozen proposal and current role reviews. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Compare current sources with reviewed bases. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>List mismatches, denied reads, and pending publications. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Stop consequential writes until owners resolve each mismatch. </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**贡献者在起草前执行预检。发布者在写入前再次执行。**将版本比较记录与提案一同保存。每周检查可以补充这些读取，但不能替代它们。</p> <p>**适配器偏差示例：**POL-01 已到版本 2，而 CLAUDE.md 仍写着版本 1。停止操作，阅读经过审查的策略变更，通过受保护的 PR 更新适配器，并启动新会话。如果没有加载策略，只改版本号无法修复上下文。</p> <p>**在离线实验环境中引入来源偏差：**将提供的 ZIP 新副本解压到空的临时目录。从根目录将 <code>baseline/</code> 复制到 <code>candidate/</code>，运行 <code>python3 check.py capture --base baseline > candidate/context.json</code>，再运行 <code>python3 check.py validate --base baseline --candidate candidate</code>。记录第一次 <code>PASS</code>。在文本编辑器中打开 <code>baseline/requirement.json</code>，仅将 <code>"retention_days": 7</code> 改为 <code>"retention_days": 8</code>。再次运行相同的 validate 命令。预期退出状态为非零，并显示 <code>STALE_CONTEXT: capture the trusted base again</code>。记录两次输出和变更的来源路径。保存私人证据后删除临时解压目录，再解压一个新副本以重置环境。不要将八天变更应用到已发布的代码库，也不要把重新捕获视为所有者批准。</p> <p>**在临时代码库中引入适配器偏差：**在新的提案分支上，将已批准的 POL-01 版本 1 适配器文本复制到 CLAUDE.md，并标记为版本 1。在单独的、经过审查的策略提案中，写明包含具体新停止条件的版本 2 变更。让适配器保持版本 1。合并或运行代理之前，请审查者比较两条记录并标记适配器已过时。关闭测试提案，或通过经过审查的 PR 更新适配器，以重置测试。然后打开新会话，验证两个版本和新的停止条件。保留旧 diff 和修正后的 diff。这是文档测试，不是模拟平台拒绝。</p> <h2 id="恢复中断的发布"> <a href="#%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d%e4%b8%ad%e6%96%ad%e7%9a%84%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83" title="恢复中断的发布">恢复中断的发布</a> <a href="#%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d%e4%b8%ad%e6%96%ad%e7%9a%84%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="恢复中断的发布">#</a> </h2> <ol> <li><strong>暂停 PROP-042 发布</strong>并指定恢复负责人。</li> <li>**读取所有参与系统的实际状态。**区分已完成、失败和未尝试的操作。</li> <li><strong>请产品团队选择</strong>继续完成、经过审查的回退或暂缓。</li> <li>**准备恢复提案，**采用最新基准，并保持范围和例外不变，除非它们经过明确审查。</li> <li>**每次执行一个经过审查的步骤，**记录并回读每项结果。</li> <li>**恢复日常工作前，**验证最终状态和剩余限制。</li> </ol> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#f92672">recovery_id</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">RECOVERY-042</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#f92672">proposal_id</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">PROP-042</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#f92672">mode</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">awaiting-owner-choice</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#f92672">illustrative_state</span>: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">requirement</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">thirty-days-published</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">implementation</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">seven-days-on-main</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">runbook</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">seven-days</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">delivery</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">blocked</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#f92672">choices</span>: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">forward</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">finish approved implementation and runbook</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">backout</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">restore baseline through reviewed changes</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">hold</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">wait for evidence or access</span> </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**将示例状态替换为观察到的修订版本和值。**以前的台账条目或助手声明都不能证明已回读结果。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>选择</th> <th>适用情况</th> <th>限制</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>继续完成</strong></td> <td>批准仍有效且来源一致</td> <td>需要重新验证</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>回退</strong></td> <td>所有者撤回变更或实现失败</td> <td>无法恢复已删除的数据</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>暂缓</strong></td> <td>缺少证据或访问权限</td> <td>交付仍未完成</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**缺少证据时选择暂缓。**合成练习没有盲目覆盖的紧迫理由。明确下一角色和缺失的证据。</p> <p><strong>GitHub 恢复</strong>使用经过审查的 revert 或补偿变更。<strong>Confluence 恢复</strong>比较历史记录，并进行经过审查的恢复或补偿。<strong>Jira 恢复</strong>保留提案历史，同时重新打开或阻止交付。读取最终修订版本，不要假设历史编号会重置。</p> <h2 id="验证独立交接"> <a href="#%e9%aa%8c%e8%af%81%e7%8b%ac%e7%ab%8b%e4%ba%a4%e6%8e%a5" title="验证独立交接">验证独立交接</a> <a href="#%e9%aa%8c%e8%af%81%e7%8b%ac%e7%ab%8b%e4%ba%a4%e6%8e%a5" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="验证独立交接">#</a> </h2> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Handoff: HANDOFF-042 </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Task: PROP-042 </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Map and policy: attach current approved revisions </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Evidence: requirement, runbook, configuration references </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Ledger: completed, failed, pending </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Decision: owner choice and fixed proposal revision </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Limits: no runtime deletion test or production data </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Next role: accountable role </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Next action: one bounded step </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Stop: changed base, access denial, conflicting authority </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**使用地图和交接信息打开另一个工具或干净会话，**不要沿用之前的对话。要求重新读取来源、生成新清单并指出待处理操作。如果将手动浏览器证据标注为快照，并在写入前重新检查，这些证据仍然有效。</p> <p>**负向交接：**拒绝访问 REQ-17。预期结果应是明确阻断，而不是猜测值或特权摘录。通过管理流程仅恢复已批准的访问，然后重新验证。</p> <h2 id="先诊断再修复"> <a href="#%e5%85%88%e8%af%8a%e6%96%ad%e5%86%8d%e4%bf%ae%e5%a4%8d" title="先诊断再修复">先诊断再修复</a> <a href="#%e5%85%88%e8%af%8a%e6%96%ad%e5%86%8d%e4%bf%ae%e5%a4%8d" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="先诊断再修复">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>从状态清单开始。</strong>“助手意见不一致”描述的是回答症状，不是底层来源问题。要求任何助手修复之前，先分别读取映射的需求、配置、运行手册、策略和交付记录。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>观察结果</th> <th>诊断</th> <th>首要操作</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>两个来源一致，旧回答不同</strong></td> <td>回答上下文过时</td> <td>根据最新读取结果重建</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>需求三十天，配置七天</strong></td> <td>交付或实现不一致</td> <td>检查已批准的包和台账</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>适配器一，策略二</strong></td> <td>指令版本不一致</td> <td>阅读策略变更并修复适配器</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>来源以前可读，现在被拒绝</strong></td> <td>访问权限变更</td> <td>停止任务并请求授权审查</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>台账已完成，运行手册为七天</strong></td> <td>未有效回读便关闭</td> <td>重新打开或阻止交付并调查</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**不要把每项不一致都视为模型问题。**刷新会话能修复过时的对话上下文，但不会发布运行手册、恢复缺失权限或调和所有者之间相互矛盾的决定。选择工具操作前先指定修复负责人。</p> <h2 id="实施补偿"> <a href="#%e5%ae%9e%e6%96%bd%e8%a1%a5%e5%81%bf" title="实施补偿">实施补偿</a> <a href="#%e5%ae%9e%e6%96%bd%e8%a1%a5%e5%81%bf" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="实施补偿">#</a> </h2> <p>**中断示例：**REQ-17 中有已批准的三十天意图，交付仍待处理。配置和运行手册仍写着七天。维护者报告存在未解决的实现故障。产品团队选择恢复，而不是继续完成。</p> <ol> <li>**记录当前版本：**需求三十天，配置七天，运行手册七天，交付已阻止。</li> <li>**冻结待处理提案：**保留审查记录和发布失败证据。</li> <li>**准备需求补偿修订：**恢复到七天，同时保留期间新增的排除项和备注。</li> <li>**取得所有者审查：**注明当前来源版本和准确的恢复措辞。</li> <li>**通过授权流程发布：**回读生成的需求版本。</li> <li>**核对台账：**所有适用的已发布值均为七，原始变更未交付。</li> </ol> <p>**补偿不会删除历史。**将尝试改为三十天、该变更失败和后续恢复分别作为独立记录保留。最终来源写明七天，交付历史说明已批准的提案为何未完成。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Recovery decision: illustrative compensation </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Original proposal: PROP-042 revision 1 </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Observed mismatch: requirement 30, configuration/runbook 7 </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Owner decision: restore approved baseline intent </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Review object: fixed compensation against current requirement version </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Result: capture resulting revision and seven-day read-back </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Original delivery: withdrawn or blocked with explanation </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Limit: no runtime deletion or data restoration performed </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**明确保留其他作者添加的例外。**盲目粘贴旧页面内容可能会移除有效的中间变更。比较当前文本和预期文本，再根据当前版本审查最小补偿变更。</p> <h2 id="测试新的交接"> <a href="#%e6%b5%8b%e8%af%95%e6%96%b0%e7%9a%84%e4%ba%a4%e6%8e%a5" title="测试新的交接">测试新的交接</a> <a href="#%e6%b5%8b%e8%af%95%e6%96%b0%e7%9a%84%e4%ba%a4%e6%8e%a5" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="测试新的交接">#</a> </h2> <p>**使用干净会话和另一位审查者。**提供地图、固定版本的包、台账和恢复决策，不提供之前的聊天记录。请接收者说明当前意图、配置、操作指南和下一项获准操作。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read the mapped current sources independently. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Distinguish approved intent, committed configuration, and delivery state. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Compare them with the reviewed package and ledger. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>List missing reads and changed bases. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Recommend one bounded next action with its accountable role. </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Do not treat this handoff as approval or publication permission. </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**预期推理：**接收者在描述基准已恢复之前先验证补偿结果。如果只重复交接信息中的“七天”，就没有测试独立读取要求。应要求来源证据，而不是另一份摘要。</p> <p><strong>已完成的教学清单，合成中断：</strong></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>记录</th> <th>观察到的状态</th> <th>应保留的证据</th> <th>下一负责人</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>REQ-17</td> <td>v5 写明三十天，排除备份</td> <td>页面历史和最新读取</td> <td>产品</td> </tr> <tr> <td>受保护配置</td> <td><code>main</code> 上的 <code>base-001</code> 写明七天</td> <td>提交回读和合并被拒事件</td> <td>代码库维护者</td> </tr> <tr> <td>RUN-04</td> <td>v2 仍写明七天</td> <td>最新页面读取</td> <td>运维</td> </tr> <tr> <td>PROP-042</td> <td>r1 已批准，交付被阻止</td> <td>固定版本的审查记录和台账</td> <td>交付负责人</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>将此清单交给第二位读者，不提供旧聊天记录。只有当读者独立找到全部四种状态、指出备份排除项、确认 <code>base-001</code> 是当前受保护修订版本，并建议由所有者审查的恢复步骤时，交接才算通过。修订版本错误、遗漏例外或无依据恢复均判定失败。再次写入前记录读者引用的来源和任何修正。</p> <h2 id="决定是否恢复工作"> <a href="#%e5%86%b3%e5%ae%9a%e6%98%af%e5%90%a6%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d%e5%b7%a5%e4%bd%9c" title="决定是否恢复工作">决定是否恢复工作</a> <a href="#%e5%86%b3%e5%ae%9a%e6%98%af%e5%90%a6%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d%e5%b7%a5%e4%bd%9c" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="决定是否恢复工作">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>预检结果</th> <th>恢复决定</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>来源符合固定批准内容</strong></td> <td>继续获准的待处理步骤</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>来源变更超出审查范围</strong></td> <td>暂停，进行比较并重新审查</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>缺少读取权限</strong></td> <td>暂缓并指定访问审查者</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>策略已变更</strong></td> <td>修复适配器并重新评估任务权限</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>写入结果未知</strong></td> <td>重试前读取目标位置</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**明确恢复的验收标准。**要求回读结果一致、审查对象处于当前状态、台账已核对且有新的交接。不要因为助手声称问题已解决就关闭恢复流程。</p> <p>**完成检查：**提供观察到的状态清单、所有者决策、经过审查的修复、最终回读和独立重建。如果访问权限阻止读取，请记录阻断情况。将此证据标准用于最终项目。</p> <h2 id="故障排查与回退"> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e6%9f%a5%e4%b8%8e%e5%9b%9e%e9%80%80" title="故障排查与回退">故障排查与回退</a> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e6%9f%a5%e4%b8%8e%e5%9b%9e%e9%80%80" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="故障排查与回退">#</a> </h2> <p>**revert 冲突：**根据当前状态准备补偿变更。**恢复时丢失例外：**写入前比较整个相关部分。**旧记忆控制回答：**从已批准来源重新开始，并移除过时草稿上下文。</p> <p>**回退恢复操作：**停在最后一个已验证状态，并追加台账条目。不要删除原生审计事件，也不要强制重置受保护的历史记录。将未解决的权限问题升级给产品团队。</p> <h2 id="练习与自检"> <a href="#%e7%bb%83%e4%b9%a0%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e6%a3%80" title="练习与自检">练习与自检</a> <a href="#%e7%bb%83%e4%b9%a0%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e6%a3%80" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="练习与自检">#</a> </h2> <p>**引入过时证据、旧策略适配器和部分发布。**不作说明地将记录交给另一位审查者，并请其指出修复负责人。</p> <p>**预期推理：**产品团队负责协调需求，策略负责人负责适配器对齐，交付恢复协调人负责协调各参与方。“刷新上下文”无法完整修复所有这些情况。</p> <h2 id="主要参考资料"> <a href="#%e4%b8%bb%e8%a6%81%e5%8f%82%e8%80%83%e8%b5%84%e6%96%99" title="主要参考资料">主要参考资料</a> <a href="#%e4%b8%bb%e8%a6%81%e5%8f%82%e8%80%83%e8%b5%84%e6%96%99" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="主要参考资料">#</a> </h2> <ul> <li><strong>代码库恢复控制：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="受保护分支"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches"> <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >受保护分支</a> </span> 。</li> <li><strong>页面历史：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="Confluence 文档"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/use-confluence-for-technical-documentation/"> <a href="https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/use-confluence-for-technical-documentation/" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >Confluence 文档</a> </span> 。</li> <li><strong>指令检查：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="Claude Code 记忆"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory"> <a href="https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >Claude Code 记忆</a> </span> 。</li> </ul> <h2 id="后续步骤"> <a href="#%e5%90%8e%e7%bb%ad%e6%ad%a5%e9%aa%a4" title="后续步骤">后续步骤</a> <a href="#%e5%90%8e%e7%bb%ad%e6%ad%a5%e9%aa%a4" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="后续步骤">#</a> </h2> <p>**使用两条工作轨道和第二位读者完成 <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="Retention Capstone"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/ai-collaboration-retention-capstone/"> <a href="/articles/ai-collaboration-retention-capstone/" rel="follow me" >Retention Capstone</a> </span> 。**展示最新来源读取、版本偏差、决策负责人、经过审查的恢复、回读和独立重建。</p> Read More at https://zh.simeononsecurity.com/

item.title: GitHub AI 协作：代码库与审查边界
item.category: "人工智能" , "团队协作" , "软件工程"
item.description: 为经过审查的 AI 贡献建立来源地图、文件所有权和受保护的发布边界。
item.content:encoded: <p> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="返回 AI 协作课程"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/ai-collaboration-course-start/"> <a href="/ai-collaboration-course-start/" rel="follow me" >返回 AI 协作课程</a> </span> </p> <p>**章程获批后，维护者会建立以 GitHub 为先的发布边界。**需求、配置、策略和运行手册放在一个可丢弃的代码库中。贡献者通过 Issues 和拉取请求提出变更。你要明确已批准事实存放的位置，并在接入代理之前阻止未经审查的变更。</p> <h2 id="要点"> <a href="#%e8%a6%81%e7%82%b9" title="要点">要点</a> <a href="#%e8%a6%81%e7%82%b9" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="要点">#</a> </h2> <ul> <li><strong>受保护的 <code>main</code></strong> 是发布边界。</li> <li><strong>Issues</strong> 收集工作提案，但不批准策略。</li> <li><strong>CODEOWNERS</strong> 指定符合条件的文件审查者。</li> <li><strong>分开的用户账号</strong> 用于演示审查和拒绝控制。</li> </ul> <h2 id="开始之前"> <a href="#%e5%bc%80%e5%a7%8b%e4%b9%8b%e5%89%8d" title="开始之前">开始之前</a> <a href="#%e5%bc%80%e5%a7%8b%e4%b9%8b%e5%89%8d" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="开始之前">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>前提条件：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="试点基础"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/ai-collaboration-pilot-foundation/"> <a href="/articles/ai-collaboration-pilot-foundation/" rel="follow me" >试点基础</a> </span> 、已解压的实验包、代码库管理员，以及分开的产品和运维审查者。**预计耗时：**60 分钟。**难度：**中等。</p> <p>**计划边界：**GitHub 为 Free 计划中的公开代码库以及 Pro、Team 或 Enterprise 计划中的私有代码库提供受保护分支。公开代码库只放合成内容。在依赖规则强制执行之前，先根据受保护分支参考资料确认可见性和计划级别。</p> <p>**完成结果：**你将得到一条受保护的发布分支、文件负责人、来源地图，以及作为证据记录的拒绝测试。</p> <h2 id="创建代码库"> <a href="#%e5%88%9b%e5%bb%ba%e4%bb%a3%e7%a0%81%e5%ba%93" title="创建代码库">创建代码库</a> <a href="#%e5%88%9b%e5%bb%ba%e4%bb%a3%e7%a0%81%e5%ba%93" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="创建代码库">#</a> </h2> <ol> <li><strong>创建 <code>export-service-lab</code></strong>，包含 README 和默认分支 <strong><code>main</code></strong>。</li> <li><strong>将解压后的实验包</strong>复制到代码库根目录，保留 <strong><code>check.py</code></strong>、<strong><code>test_check.py</code></strong> 和 <strong><code>baseline/</code></strong>。将 <code>baseline/</code> 中的基线记录文件复制到根目录，作为初始记录。</li> <li><strong>创建 <code>docs/project-map.md</code></strong>，使用试点基础材料中的登记表。添加包含已批准 POL-01 的 <strong><code>docs/policy.md</code></strong>。</li> <li><strong>创建 <code>docs/decisions/DEC-12.md</code></strong>，记录章程批准、角色、基线决策和状态。</li> <li>**以管理员身份提交初始配置。**记录这项初始例外。后续贡献前启用保护。</li> </ol> <p>**在 Git Bash、macOS 终端或 Linux shell 中进行本地初始化：**在浏览器中登录 GitHub，打开新代码库，选择 <strong>Code</strong> 并复制 HTTPS 克隆 URL。在一次性工作目录中运行以下命令。将两个占位路径替换为该 URL 和下载的实验 ZIP 路径。不要把令牌粘贴到 URL 中。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span style="display:flex;"><span>git --version </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>git clone <span style="color:#e6db74">"https://github.com/OWNER/export-service-lab.git"</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>cd export-service-lab </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>unzip -n <span style="color:#e6db74">"/absolute/path/to/ai-collaboration-lab.zip"</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>cp baseline/config.json baseline/policy.json baseline/proposal.json baseline/requirement.json baseline/runbook.md . </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>mkdir -p docs/decisions </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>git status --short </span></span></code></pre></div><p>clone 命令应创建代码库目录。如果没有 <code>unzip</code>，请用文件管理器解压 ZIP，并将内容复制到此 checkout，同时保留代码库的 README。<code>git status --short</code> 应将复制的记录、检查器、测试和 <code>baseline/</code> 列为新文件。用文本编辑器从试点材料中保存 <code>docs/project-map.md</code>、<code>docs/policy.md</code> 和 <code>docs/decisions/DEC-12.md</code>。然后运行：</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span style="display:flex;"><span>git add README.md baseline check.py test_check.py config.json policy.json proposal.json requirement.json runbook.md docs </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>git commit -m <span style="color:#e6db74">"Add synthetic collaboration baseline"</span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>git push origin main </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>git status --short </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>git remote -v </span></span></code></pre></div><p>Git 应报告新的提交 ID，随后成功推送到 <code>main</code>。最后的简短状态应为空。在新的浏览器窗口中打开 GitHub 代码库，确认文件和提交 ID 出现在 <code>main</code> 上。保存提交 URL，作为初始化证据。如果 Git 要求设置作者身份，请按课程中心的配置桥接说明操作。如果身份验证失败，使用 GitHub 支持的凭据流程，然后重试同一项推送。如果分支或远程仓库不正确，请停下并在下一次写入前检查 <code>git branch --show-current</code> 和 <code>git remote -v</code>。如果保护已启用导致推送被拒绝，请打开提案分支和 PR，不要绕过规则。维护者也可以使用下面的纯浏览器流程。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>记录</th> <th>位置</th> <th>负责人</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>POL-01</strong></td> <td><code>policy.json</code>、<code>docs/policy.md</code></td> <td>策略负责人</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>REQ-17</strong></td> <td><code>requirement.json</code></td> <td>产品负责人</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>RUN-04</strong></td> <td><code>runbook.md</code></td> <td>运维负责人</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>行为</strong></td> <td><code>config.json</code></td> <td>代码库维护者</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>决策</strong></td> <td><code>docs/decisions/</code></td> <td>项目负责人</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**地图链接到位置，不复制值。**让 README 专注于设置和地图。即使在一个代码库中，重复写入保留期限要求也会造成偏差。</p> <h2 id="指定文件负责人"> <a href="#%e6%8c%87%e5%ae%9a%e6%96%87%e4%bb%b6%e8%b4%9f%e8%b4%a3%e4%ba%ba" title="指定文件负责人">指定文件负责人</a> <a href="#%e6%8c%87%e5%ae%9a%e6%96%87%e4%bb%b6%e8%b4%9f%e8%b4%a3%e4%ba%ba" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="指定文件负责人">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>在本地生成 <code>.github/CODEOWNERS</code></strong>，使用沙箱中的真实账号名。输入时去掉开头的 <strong><code>@</code></strong>。账号身份应留在私有实验环境中，不要放入公开练习证据。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span style="display:flex;"><span>python3 - <span style="color:#e6db74"><<'PY' </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">from pathlib import Path </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">roles = ['product', 'operations', 'maintainer', 'policy'] </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">handles = {r: input(r + ' GitHub handle: ').strip().lstrip('@') for r in roles} </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">if any(not h or not all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in h) for h in handles.values()): </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> raise SystemExit('Invalid handle') </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">paths = {'requirement.json': 'product', 'runbook.md': 'operations', </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> 'config.json': 'maintainer', 'policy.json': 'policy', </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> 'docs/policy.md': 'policy', 'AGENTS.md': 'policy', </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> 'CLAUDE.md': 'policy', '.clinerules/': 'policy', </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> '.github/': 'maintainer', 'check.py': 'maintainer', </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> 'test_check.py': 'maintainer', 'baseline/': 'maintainer'} </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">Path('.github').mkdir(exist_ok=True) </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">Path('.github/CODEOWNERS').write_text(''.join( </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74"> '/' + path + ' @' + handles[role] + '\n' for path, role in paths.items())) </span></span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span><span style="color:#e6db74">PY</span> </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**GitHub 要求负责人拥有写入权限，才会识别他们。**在浏览器中检查 CODEOWNERS 文件是否有错误。与普通内容一样，保护所有权文件和工作流定义。</p> <p>**同一行列出多个姓名，并不要求所有负责人都批准。**对于匹配的路径，GitHub 接受一位符合条件的负责人批准。需求路径和运行手册路径应指定不同负责人。试点还要求产品负责人和运维负责人的确认与最终提案关联。</p> <h2 id="保护发布流程"> <a href="#%e4%bf%9d%e6%8a%a4%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83%e6%b5%81%e7%a8%8b" title="保护发布流程">保护发布流程</a> <a href="#%e4%bf%9d%e6%8a%a4%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83%e6%b5%81%e7%a8%8b" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="保护发布流程">#</a> </h2> <ol> <li><strong>打开 Settings、Branches</strong>，为 <strong><code>main</code></strong> 添加分支保护规则。本练习中始终使用分支保护，不要与 rulesets 混用。</li> <li>**要求拉取请求、**两项批准审查，以及代码负责人审查。</li> <li>新提交后<strong>撤销过期批准</strong>，并要求解决评论讨论。</li> <li>**启用禁止绕过上述设置。**禁用强制推送和删除。</li> <li>在下个模块首次运行后，**添加一致性检查。**合并前要求分支保持最新。</li> </ol> <p>**两项批准强制的是数量，不是业务角色成员身份。**CODEOWNERS 提供基于路径的负责人覆盖。维护者还要检查两个角色的确认。应明确记录这项程序性控制，不要将其描述为自动强制双角色审批。</p> <p>**管理员仍然管理配置。**在测试前后截取规则状态。不要授予代理管理员权限，也不要用特权令牌演示拒绝贡献者操作。</p> <h2 id="验证边界"> <a href="#%e9%aa%8c%e8%af%81%e8%be%b9%e7%95%8c" title="验证边界">验证边界</a> <a href="#%e9%aa%8c%e8%af%81%e8%be%b9%e7%95%8c" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="验证边界">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>尝试</th> <th>预期结果</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>贡献者提交分支</strong></td> <td>允许提出变更</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>贡献者直接发布</strong></td> <td>受保护的发布被拒绝</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>一位审查者批准</strong></td> <td>合并被审查门槛阻止</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>审查后出现新提交</strong></td> <td>需要新的批准</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>敏感文件没有负责人覆盖</strong></td> <td>发布前修复</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**使用贡献者的浏览器会话检查操作路径。**GitHub 网页编辑器不会编辑受保护的 <strong><code>main</code></strong>。系统提示创建分支，说明存在受支持的浏览器路径，但无法证明服务器拒绝了直接推送。要取得平台拒绝证据，请让拥有获批本地 Git 权限的贡献者尝试向受保护的 <strong><code>main</code></strong> 直接推送一项无害变更，并保留服务器响应。如果没有本地访问权限，则将拒绝测试标为“受阻”。</p> <p><strong>拒绝后读取 <code>main</code></strong>，确认修订版本没有变化。记录操作者角色、尝试的操作、结果和来源修订版本。助手承诺不发布属于行为证据，不是平台权限测试。</p> <p>**直接推送测试使用贡献者本人通过身份验证的本地克隆。**维护者令牌会测试错误的身份。此示例响应展示了应保留的服务器证据类型。具体措辞因代码库规则而异。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Actor role: contributor </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Attempt: harmless synthetic direct push to main </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Remote result: rejected, protected branch update denied </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Initial main commit: [record sandbox commit] </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Final main commit: [record same commit after read-back] </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Decision: platform denial supported only if both records are observed </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**如果本地 Git 身份验证不可用，将服务器端拒绝标为“受阻”。**保留浏览器创建分支的提示，作为路径证据，然后请维护者安排单独的贡献者测试。不要把路径提示算作直接推送被拒。</p> <h2 id="建立实用的来源地图"> <a href="#%e5%bb%ba%e7%ab%8b%e5%ae%9e%e7%94%a8%e7%9a%84%e6%9d%a5%e6%ba%90%e5%9c%b0%e5%9b%be" title="建立实用的来源地图">建立实用的来源地图</a> <a href="#%e5%bb%ba%e7%ab%8b%e5%ae%9e%e7%94%a8%e7%9a%84%e6%9d%a5%e6%ba%90%e5%9c%b0%e5%9b%be" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="建立实用的来源地图">#</a> </h2> <p>**来源地图是导航文档，**不是第二份需求文档。从聊天进入的人应能找到当前意图、已实现行为和操作说明，而不必在相互冲突的摘要间选择。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Project: export-service-lab </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Track: GitHub-first </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Approved boundary: protected main </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>REQ-17 -> requirement.json </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Authority: retention intent for synthetic export files </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Owner: product-owner </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Revision: record revision plus protected commit </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>RUN-04 -> runbook.md </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Authority: operating instructions for the synthetic lab </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Owner: operations-owner </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Revision: protected commit </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Behavior -> config.json </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Authority: committed retention configuration </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Owner: repository-maintainer </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Revision: protected commit </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Proposals -> Issues and proposal branches </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> Authority: requested changes only </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**不要在地图的每个条目里都写当前保留期限。**如果地图记录“七天”，PROP-042 后就又多出一个需要同步的值。地图只保留稳定标识和位置，具体值应从权威记录中读取。</p> <p>**将地图变更作为路由变更来保护。**把 REQ-17 重定向到草稿文件会改变来源选择，即使已批准的需求本身没有改动。地图变更时，检查目标位置、负责人和权限范围。</p> <h2 id="分开基线与候选版本"> <a href="#%e5%88%86%e5%bc%80%e5%9f%ba%e7%ba%bf%e4%b8%8e%e5%80%99%e9%80%89%e7%89%88%e6%9c%ac" title="分开基线与候选版本">分开基线与候选版本</a> <a href="#%e5%88%86%e5%bc%80%e5%9f%ba%e7%ba%bf%e4%b8%8e%e5%80%99%e9%80%89%e7%89%88%e6%9c%ac" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="分开基线与候选版本">#</a> </h2> <p>**代码库根目录包含实验室当前使用的记录。**下载的 <strong><code>baseline/</code></strong> 目录是教学用样例，不会自动成为每个后续 PR 的受保护基线。经过审查的工作进入 <strong><code>main</code></strong> 后，根目录中的受保护记录将成为下一项提案的基线。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>位置</th> <th>用途</th> <th>在 PROP-042 中编辑？</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>根目录的 requirement/config/runbook</strong></td> <td>分支上的当前候选记录</td> <td>可以，通过已审查的变更</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong><code>baseline/</code></strong></td> <td>原始离线练习样例</td> <td>不可以</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>分离的可信 worktree</strong></td> <td>捕获的受保护根目录记录</td> <td>不可以</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong><code>context.json</code></strong></td> <td>已捕获基线字节的证据</td> <td>对账后重新生成</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**将控制措施变更与保留期限变更分开。**先初始化检查器和审查规则，再提出从七天改为三十天。把策略、工作流和数值变更混在一起，会让审查者难以分辨修复的控制和被绕过的控制。</p> <h2 id="审查完整变更"> <a href="#%e5%ae%a1%e6%9f%a5%e5%ae%8c%e6%95%b4%e5%8f%98%e6%9b%b4" title="审查完整变更">审查完整变更</a> <a href="#%e5%ae%a1%e6%9f%a5%e5%ae%8c%e6%95%b4%e5%8f%98%e6%9b%b4" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="审查完整变更">#</a> </h2> <p>**接受 PR 描述之前，先打开 Files changed。**描述说明作者意图，diff 展示提交的变更。对于 PROP-042，检查需求修订、范围排除项、配置、运行手册、提案基线和清单证据。</p> <ol> <li>**产品审查：**确认三十天意图和未变化的排除项。</li> <li>**运维审查：**确认运行手册与提议的配置一致，并保留运行环境限制。</li> <li>**维护者审查：**检查 JSON、来源捕获、检查结果和无关编辑。</li> <li>**控制审查：**单独检查地图、策略、CODEOWNERS 或工作流变更。</li> </ol> <p>**绿色检查无法解释无关删除。**如果分支在更改保留期限时删除了策略文档，请求单独的提案或明确指定的负责人审查。限制范围有助于审查者理解审查对象。</p> <h2 id="诊断拒绝测试"> <a href="#%e8%af%8a%e6%96%ad%e6%8b%92%e7%bb%9d%e6%b5%8b%e8%af%95" title="诊断拒绝测试">诊断拒绝测试</a> <a href="#%e8%af%8a%e6%96%ad%e6%8b%92%e7%bb%9d%e6%b5%8b%e8%af%95" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="诊断拒绝测试">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>每行证据只记录一项尝试的操作。</strong>“贡献者失败了”含义不清。用户可能缺少普通写权限、遇到浏览器限制，或触发预期的分支规则。这些观察说明的是不同边界。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>观察</th> <th>解释</th> <th>后续操作</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>无法创建任何分支</strong></td> <td>没有贡献权限</td> <td>使用获批的 Issue 或 fork 路径</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>能创建分支，但不能发布到 main</strong></td> <td>测试的发布路径受到限制</td> <td>记录未变化的 main 修订版本</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>一项审查后合并被阻止</strong></td> <td>测试 PR 的审查数量规则生效</td> <td>添加角色相关证据</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>管理员仍能绕过规则发布</strong></td> <td>测试身份绕过了边界</td> <td>检查绕过设置和授权</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**在课程共享证据中记录角色和操作，不要暴露账号详情。**将原始操作者记录私下留给审查者。将规则配置、尝试操作、拒绝结果和最终受保护修订版本一起保存。</p> <h2 id="代码库完成检查"> <a href="#%e4%bb%a3%e7%a0%81%e5%ba%93%e5%ae%8c%e6%88%90%e6%a3%80%e6%9f%a5" title="代码库完成检查">代码库完成检查</a> <a href="#%e4%bb%a3%e7%a0%81%e5%ba%93%e5%ae%8c%e6%88%90%e6%a3%80%e6%9f%a5" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="代码库完成检查">#</a> </h2> <p>**交付一个其他贡献者能够独立浏览的代码库。**README 指向地图，地图指向权威记录，负责人覆盖包括敏感路径，保护规则适用于 <strong><code>main</code></strong>。保留一项获准的提案和一次被拒绝的发布尝试。</p> <p>**不要只凭设置就宣称强制措施有效。**设置说明预期配置，沙箱尝试说明特定角色和路径下观察到的行为。在代理和 GitHub Actions 课程中同时使用这两类证据。</p> <h2 id="故障排查与回退"> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e6%9f%a5%e4%b8%8e%e5%9b%9e%e9%80%80" title="故障排查与回退">故障排查与回退</a> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e6%9f%a5%e4%b8%8e%e5%9b%9e%e9%80%80" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="故障排查与回退">#</a> </h2> <p>**缺少负责人的请求：**确认写入权限和基线分支路径覆盖。**缺少保护：**检查计划和可见性。**仍可合并：**检查规则目标、绕过设置和审查数量。</p> <p>**回退：**关闭未合并的提案并停用实验室自动化。通过另一个经过审查的 PR 回退已合并的实验内容。删除一次性代码库前先保留证据。不要为了完成失败的测试而削弱保护。</p> <h2 id="练习与自检"> <a href="#%e7%bb%83%e4%b9%a0%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e6%a3%80" title="练习与自检">练习与自检</a> <a href="#%e7%bb%83%e4%b9%a0%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e6%a3%80" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="练习与自检">#</a> </h2> <p>**作为贡献者，提议编辑 <code>docs/policy.md</code>。**判断维护者单独批准是否足以代表策略负责人的批准。</p> <p>**预期推理：**审查数量本身不能证明权限。该路径需要策略负责人覆盖和当前角色审查。将未被自动强制执行的角色要求列为程序性控制。</p> <h2 id="主要参考资料"> <a href="#%e4%b8%bb%e8%a6%81%e5%8f%82%e8%80%83%e8%b5%84%e6%96%99" title="主要参考资料">主要参考资料</a> <a href="#%e4%b8%bb%e8%a6%81%e5%8f%82%e8%80%83%e8%b5%84%e6%96%99" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="主要参考资料">#</a> </h2> <ul> <li><strong>计划和审查控制：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="受保护分支"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches"> <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >受保护分支</a> </span> 。</li> <li><strong>负责人资格：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="代码负责人"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-code-owners"> <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-code-owners" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >代码负责人</a> </span> 。</li> <li><strong>通过浏览器贡献：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="编辑文件"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/working-with-files/managing-files/editing-files"> <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/working-with-files/managing-files/editing-files" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >编辑文件</a> </span> 。</li> </ul> <h2 id="后续步骤"> <a href="#%e5%90%8e%e7%bb%ad%e6%ad%a5%e9%aa%a4" title="后续步骤">后续步骤</a> <a href="#%e5%90%8e%e7%bb%ad%e6%ad%a5%e9%aa%a4" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="后续步骤">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>继续学习 <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="代理适配器与 GitHub Actions"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/ai-collaboration-github-agents-actions/"> <a href="/articles/ai-collaboration-github-agents-actions/" rel="follow me" >代理适配器与 GitHub Actions</a> </span> </strong>，将来源证据连接到可执行检查。</p> Read More at https://zh.simeononsecurity.com/

item.title: GitHub、Confluence 与 Jira 的 AI 发布工作流
item.category: "人工智能" , "团队协作" , "软件工程"
item.description: 通过版本检查和部分发布恢复，在 Confluence、GitHub 与 Jira 中发布固定的保留期限提案。
item.content:encoded: <p> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="返回 AI 协作课程"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/ai-collaboration-course-start/"> <a href="/ai-collaboration-course-start/" rel="follow me" >返回 AI 协作课程</a> </span> </p> <p><strong>贡献者在负责人批准前冻结 PROP-042。</strong> Confluence 发布者更新需求，GitHub 维护者合并实现，运维团队发布运行手册。Jira 记录每个步骤。请先核实权限，因为这三个系统不会构成一个原子事务。发布台账会显示未完成的交付。</p> <h2 id="关键要点"> <a href="#%e5%85%b3%e9%94%ae%e8%a6%81%e7%82%b9" title="关键要点">关键要点</a> <a href="#%e5%85%b3%e9%94%ae%e8%a6%81%e7%82%b9" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="关键要点">#</a> </h2> <ul> <li><strong>已批准的意图</strong>与实际交付行为不同。</li> <li><strong>固定的提案修订版</strong>将评审绑定到特定版本。</li> <li><strong>发布台账</strong>会暴露未完成的步骤。</li> <li><strong>重新读取最新来源</strong>可防范基线变化。</li> </ul> <h2 id="开始之前"> <a href="#%e5%bc%80%e5%a7%8b%e4%b9%8b%e5%89%8d" title="开始之前">开始之前</a> <a href="#%e5%bc%80%e5%a7%8b%e4%b9%8b%e5%89%8d" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="开始之前">#</a> </h2> <p><strong>前置条件：</strong> <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="工作环境设置"> <meta itemprop="url" content="/articles/ai-collaboration-confluence-jira-setup/"> <a href="/articles/ai-collaboration-confluence-jira-setup/" rel="follow me" >工作环境设置</a> </span> 、发布权限、负责人和仓库维护者。**预计时间：**两小时。**难度：**高级协调。</p> <p>**基础界面：**在浏览器中读取，可选择在已批准的聊天中起草，由人工执行发布。此流程不假设你订阅了连接器。添加集成前，请检查租户中的可用性、权限范围、供应商的数据处理方式和身份映射。切勿将负责人的凭据分享给贡献者。</p> <p>**读者成果：**完成后，你将拥有固定提案、按系统划分的发布台账、回读证据，以及针对第一个未完成步骤的恢复决策。本练习验证流程与证据处理，不验证生产环境中的保留行为。</p> <h2 id="记录当前来源"> <a href="#%e8%ae%b0%e5%bd%95%e5%bd%93%e5%89%8d%e6%9d%a5%e6%ba%90" title="记录当前来源">记录当前来源</a> <a href="#%e8%ae%b0%e5%bd%95%e5%bd%93%e5%89%8d%e6%9d%a5%e6%ba%90" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="记录当前来源">#</a> </h2> <ol> <li><strong>读取 MAP-01</strong>，然后通过映射的页面 ID 打开 REQ-17 和 RUN-04。</li> <li><strong>打开页面菜单和 Page History</strong>，记录数字版本、状态、措辞、负责人和例外。</li> <li><strong>读取 Jira 项目</strong>，并附上固定的提案导出文件或 GitHub commit。项目键本身无法冻结评审证据。</li> <li><strong>读取已批准的 POL-01</strong> 和受保护的配置基线。</li> <li><strong>只向聊天提供必要的合成摘录</strong>，标记为快照，并禁用所有可写操作。</li> </ol> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Task: PROP-042, propose only </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Authority: Confluence REQ-17 for intent, GitHub for behavior </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Read: mapped current pages, versions, scope, exceptions </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Proposal: synthetic export retention from 7 to 30 days </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Output: requirement wording, config diff, runbook, ledger </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Evidence: source ID and captured revision for each factual claim </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Unknowns: missing access and absent runtime observations </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Stop: conflict, changed base, or denied access </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**离线资料包仍基于快照。**发布者在写入前重新读取当前来源。访问被拒会阻止发布。旧导出文件不能替代当前授权。</p> <h2 id="固定提案"> <a href="#%e5%9b%ba%e5%ae%9a%e6%8f%90%e6%a1%88" title="固定提案">固定提案</a> <a href="#%e5%9b%ba%e5%ae%9a%e6%8f%90%e6%a1%88" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="固定提案">#</a> </h2> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-json" data-lang="json"><span style="display:flex;"><span>{ </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"proposal_id"</span>: <span style="color:#e6db74">"PROP-042"</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"proposal_revision"</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">1</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"requirement_base_version"</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">1</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"runbook_base_version"</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">1</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"policy_version"</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">1</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"from_days"</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">7</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"to_days"</span>: <span style="color:#ae81ff">30</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"status"</span>: <span style="color:#e6db74">"awaiting-owner-review"</span>, </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> <span style="color:#f92672">"publication_order"</span>: [<span style="color:#e6db74">"requirement"</span>, <span style="color:#e6db74">"implementation"</span>, <span style="color:#e6db74">"runbook"</span>, <span style="color:#e6db74">"delivery"</span>] </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>} </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**将示例页面版本替换为实际捕获的版本。**将固定 JSON 和拟议措辞附加到 Jira。每位负责人记录自己的角色、决定、提案修订版、来源版本和评审时间。任何实质性编辑都会让资料包返回 <code>Review</code>。</p> <p>**产品团队评审意图和范围。运维团队评审清理和恢复。**维护者评审 diff。对可变聊天消息的回应不构成绑定到修订版的批准。</p> <h2 id="发布并回读"> <a href="#%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83%e5%b9%b6%e5%9b%9e%e8%af%bb" title="发布并回读">发布并回读</a> <a href="#%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83%e5%b9%b6%e5%9b%9e%e8%af%bb" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="发布并回读">#</a> </h2> <ol> <li><strong>发布者核实两位负责人的评审且确认来源基线未变后，将 Jira 转为 <code>Publishing</code>。</strong></li> <li><strong>发布 REQ-17</strong>，将保留期限设为三十天，并添加待交付字段。记录结果页面版本、范围和例外。</li> <li><strong>打开 GitHub 实现 PR</strong>，引用已批准的页面版本。将配置改为三十天，并附上不具权威性的需求快照。</li> <li><strong>仓库评审通过后合并</strong>，并回读 <strong><code>main</code></strong>。分别记录仓库中的已提交行为和运行时行为。</li> <li><strong>发布 RUN-04</strong>，按 ID 回读并记录结果版本。发布者更新需求中的交付引用。</li> <li><strong>仅在所有记录一致且附有最终回读证据后完成 Jira。</strong></li> </ol> <p>**本地验证器仅用于检查快照一致性。**将变更前的 Confluence 需求复制到实验室基线 JSON 架构中并捕获，然后把候选版本改为三十天。递增本地快照修订版，同时在 Jira 中单独保留实际 Confluence 版本。以 GitHub 为根源的工作流不会验证实时 Confluence。不要把绿色状态说成已核验外部权威来源。</p> <p>**本练习中不要部署删除功能。**真实服务需要部署证据、受控测试数据、临时暂停删除的机制和运行时边界测试。合并只能证明仓库状态，不能证明生产环境中的保留行为。</p> <h2 id="跟踪部分发布"> <a href="#%e8%b7%9f%e8%b8%aa%e9%83%a8%e5%88%86%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83" title="跟踪部分发布">跟踪部分发布</a> <a href="#%e8%b7%9f%e8%b8%aa%e9%83%a8%e5%88%86%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="跟踪部分发布">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>步骤</th> <th>初始状态</th> <th>完成证据</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>REQ-17</strong></td> <td>Pending</td> <td>结果页面版本</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>配置</strong></td> <td>Pending</td> <td>已合并的 commit 和评审</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>RUN-04</strong></td> <td>Pending</td> <td>结果页面版本</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>关闭 Jira</strong></td> <td>Pending</td> <td>最终回读和状态转换</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**先记录每项结果，再尝试下一步。**PROP-042 将各系统事件关联起来。完成一行并不表示整个变更已经完成。</p> <p>**失败示例：**Confluence 已发布三十天，但 GitHub 拒绝合并。将 Jira 保持在 <code>Blocked</code>，并将需求标记为待交付。产品团队选择继续完成，或经评审后恢复为七天。不要把应急 README 副本提升为需求权威来源。</p> <h2 id="处理并发编辑"> <a href="#%e5%a4%84%e7%90%86%e5%b9%b6%e5%8f%91%e7%bc%96%e8%be%91" title="处理并发编辑">处理并发编辑</a> <a href="#%e5%a4%84%e7%90%86%e5%b9%b6%e5%8f%91%e7%bc%96%e8%be%91" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="处理并发编辑">#</a> </h2> <p>**浏览器基线：**在试点期间指定一位发布者。编辑前立即重新打开 Page History，并在发布后再次打开。如果其他作者修改了来源，请停止、比较、协调并重新审批。串行发布是一种流程，并不保证原子事务。</p> <p>**API 扩展：**Confluence v2 文档说明了 <strong><code>GET /wiki/api/v2/pages/{id}?body-format=storage</code></strong> 和带版本对象的 <strong><code>PUT /wiki/api/v2/pages/{id}</code></strong>。经过评审的发布集成会将当前版本与已批准基线比较，提交下一版本并回读。不要自动刷新失败版本，也不要用旧正文重试。</p> <p>**API 成功本身不够。**检查结果内容、来源 ID、范围和版本。本课程不提供可写 API 客户端。人工通过浏览器发布是非程序员可执行的基线流程。</p> <h2 id="验证负面情形"> <a href="#%e9%aa%8c%e8%af%81%e8%b4%9f%e9%9d%a2%e6%83%85%e5%bd%a2" title="验证负面情形">验证负面情形</a> <a href="#%e9%aa%8c%e8%af%81%e8%b4%9f%e9%9d%a2%e6%83%85%e5%bd%a2" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="验证负面情形">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>注入情形</th> <th>预期判断</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>审批后更改来源</strong></td> <td>停止，并基于新版本重新审批</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>移除发布者的编辑权限</strong></td> <td>拒绝更新，并保留待处理台账</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>将 Jira 设为六十天</strong></td> <td>停止冲突，并保留 Confluence 的权威性</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>运行手册发布失败</strong></td> <td>保持交付未完成，并分配恢复工作</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p><strong>记录沙箱中的实际结果</strong>，包括执行者角色和前后修订版。不要在被拒用户的证据中包含受保护页面正文。预期结果不等于实测结果。</p> <h2 id="整理评审资料包"> <a href="#%e6%95%b4%e7%90%86%e8%af%84%e5%ae%a1%e8%b5%84%e6%96%99%e5%8c%85" title="整理评审资料包">整理评审资料包</a> <a href="#%e6%95%b4%e7%90%86%e8%af%84%e5%ae%a1%e8%b5%84%e6%96%99%e5%8c%85" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="整理评审资料包">#</a> </h2> <p>**冻结内容，而不只是提案标签。**PROP-042 会出现在每个系统中，但标签无法识别负责人评审的具体正文。将精确的需求措辞、实现 diff、运行手册措辞、来源版本和发布顺序放入同一个固定资料包。</p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>Package: PROP-042 revision 1, illustrative </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Intent: synthetic export retention changes from 7 to 30 days </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Exclusions: production data, backups, legal holds </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Requirement amendment: fixed proposed REQ-17 wording </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Implementation: fixed candidate diff and protected base reference </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Runbook amendment: fixed RUN-04 wording and recovery limits </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Review: product and operations decisions for this package </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Delivery: requirement -> implementation -> runbook -> closure </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>Stop: changed source, missing review, denied write, failed read-back </span></span></code></pre></div><p>**让两位负责人都能读懂资料包。**产品团队需要了解意图和排除项。运维团队需要了解操作变化和恢复边界。双方都要理解已批准意图与已交付配置不一致的时间段。对于不熟悉仓库文件的负责人，仅有代码 diff 不够。</p> <p><strong>此合成示例的完整资料包内容：</strong></p> <div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" style="color:#f8f8f2;background-color:#272822;-moz-tab-size:4;-o-tab-size:4;tab-size:4;-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;"><code class="language-text" data-lang="text"><span style="display:flex;"><span>REQ-17 proposed v5: "Synthetic export files are retained for 30 days from creation. This pilot excludes production data, backups, and legal holds. Delivery remains pending until the GitHub configuration and RUN-04 read-backs match this approved wording." </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>GitHub config.json, proposed change against base-001: </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>- "retention_days": 7 </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>+ "retention_days": 30 </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span> </span></span><span style="display:flex;"><span>RUN-04 proposed v3: "Retention days: 30. Synthetic exports only. No deletion job runs in this lab. If publication fails, keep delivery pending, read back each source, and obtain owner approval before restoring the seven-day configuration or completing the thirty-day publication." </span></span></code></pre></div><p>这些句子是示例提案文本，不是实时租户记录。评审前附上实际基线 commit 和页面版本。固定资料包必须包含完整的拟议正文，而不是让负责人自行推断内容的摘要。</p> <p>**将离线快照与实时发布分开。**首次写入前，发布者重新检查映射页面，维护者重新检查受保护基线。任何一项发生变化，旧资料包都会停在 <code>Review</code>。</p> <h2 id="查看台账"> <a href="#%e6%9f%a5%e7%9c%8b%e5%8f%b0%e8%b4%a6" title="查看台账">查看台账</a> <a href="#%e6%9f%a5%e7%9c%8b%e5%8f%b0%e8%b4%a6" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="查看台账">#</a> </h2> <p>**示例状态推进：**表格使用教学版本号，不代表观测结果。在沙箱中每次写入后填写真实的结果版本和 commit。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>步骤</th> <th>回读成功后的状态</th> <th>剩余工作</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>负责人评审完成</strong></td> <td>提案已批准，所有已发布值为七天</td> <td>全部发布步骤</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>REQ-17 已发布</strong></td> <td>意图设为三十天，交付待处理</td> <td>配置和运行手册</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>GitHub 合并已回读</strong></td> <td>意图/配置为三十天，运行手册为七天</td> <td>运行手册和最终协调</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>RUN-04 已发布</strong></td> <td>所有适用记录为三十天</td> <td>独立最终回读</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>交付已关闭</strong></td> <td>台账完整并附证据</td> <td>已声明的运行时差距仍存在</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**交付待处理是有意义的状态。**在发布未完成时，它能避免把旧实现描述为符合新意图。在此期间，读者需要同时了解两个值，而不是只看到“保留期限为三十天”的摘要。</p> <p>**将失败尝试追加为独立事件。**如果运行手册写入失败，保留需求和配置已成功发布的结果。记录尝试的操作、失败、未变化的版本、分配的角色和下一步。不要把已完成行重置为 Pending，也不要抹去已观察到的顺序。</p> <p>**旧版本拒绝示例：**发布者读取 REQ-17 v4，另一位获授权的编辑者发布 v5，然后发布者尝试基于 v4 应用 PROP-042 r1。平台报告版本冲突，或写入前读取发现 v5。记录执行者 <code>publisher</code>、初始版本 <code>v4</code>、尝试的 <code>PROP-042 r1</code>、观察到的冲突或当前版本变化、此次尝试未改变的最终版本 <code>v5</code>，以及分配的负责人 <code>product owner</code>。保持 Jira 为 <code>Review</code>。重新读取 v5、协调措辞，并在再次写入前请求评审新的固定资料包。实时测试时使用实际平台响应和 Page History。此行是教学示例。</p> <p><strong>已完成的教学示例，仅用合成值：</strong></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>系统</th> <th>初始来源</th> <th>固定评审</th> <th>写入和回读</th> <th>最终状态</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>Confluence REQ-17</td> <td>v4，七天</td> <td>PROP-042 r1，产品团队批准从 v4 改为 v5</td> <td>发布者写入 v5，评审者重新打开 v5</td> <td>三十天，排除备份和法律保留</td> </tr> <tr> <td>GitHub 配置</td> <td><code>main</code> commit <code>base-001</code>，七天</td> <td>PROP-042 r1，运维团队批准候选 diff</td> <td>PR 合并为 <code>merge-002</code>，独立克隆读取到三十</td> <td>受保护源中为三十天</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Confluence RUN-04</td> <td>v2，七天</td> <td>PROP-042 r1，运维团队批准从 v2 改为 v3</td> <td>发布者写入 v3，评审者重新打开 v3</td> <td>带回退方案的三十天操作步骤</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Jira PROP-042</td> <td>In Review</td> <td>两位负责人的决定绑定到 r1</td> <td>交付负责人附上证据并转为 Done</td> <td>三项回读后关闭</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>以上标签仅作说明，不是租户证据。台账需要原生页面版本链接和 commit ID。将 Jira 转为 Done 前，附上冻结提案、两种角色的评审、来源基线记录、每项发布回读、负面测试结果和未解决的运行时限制。缺少任何一项时，保持交付开放或 <code>Blocked</code>。</p> <p>**资料包门槛：**将五项检查分别标记为 <code>Supported</code> 或 <code>Blocked</code>：来源修订版是最新的，两位负责人批准了相同的固定修订版，所有必要发布都与回读一致，运行时限制仍明确，恢复状态已协调。<code>Done</code> 要求五项检查全部为 <code>Supported</code>，且没有未授权写入。</p> <h2 id="处理不确定的写入"> <a href="#%e5%a4%84%e7%90%86%e4%b8%8d%e7%a1%ae%e5%ae%9a%e7%9a%84%e5%86%99%e5%85%a5" title="处理不确定的写入">处理不确定的写入</a> <a href="#%e5%a4%84%e7%90%86%e4%b8%8d%e7%a1%ae%e5%ae%9a%e7%9a%84%e5%86%99%e5%85%a5" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="处理不确定的写入">#</a> </h2> <p>**超时会让结果处于未知状态。**它既不能证明成功，也不能证明失败。在浏览器基线流程中，先重新打开映射来源并检查当前内容和历史，再决定是否重试。</p> <ol> <li>**暂停下一步：**保持交付未完成。</li> <li>**读取目标：**将当前措辞、版本和范围与固定资料包比较。</li> <li>**记录观察结果：**已完成、未变化、冲突或无法访问。</li> <li>**选择下一步：**从已验证的完成状态继续，重试未变化且已获授权的步骤，或上报冲突。</li> <li>**保留不确定性：**将失败/未知尝试与后续回读一起保留。</li> </ol> <p>**不要盲目重放整个流程。**重复已完成的步骤会增加修订版，并可能覆盖无关编辑。应从已验证状态继续。如果无法访问来源，选择 <code>Hold</code>，不要根据旧台账猜测。</p> <h2 id="比较恢复决策"> <a href="#%e6%af%94%e8%be%83%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d%e5%86%b3%e7%ad%96" title="比较恢复决策">比较恢复决策</a> <a href="#%e6%af%94%e8%be%83%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d%e5%86%b3%e7%ad%96" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="比较恢复决策">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>情况</th> <th>要评审的决策</th> <th>原因</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><strong>需求已变更，合并被拒</strong></td> <td>继续完成需求，或对需求做补偿</td> <td>意图与行为不同</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>配置已变更，运行手册被拒</strong></td> <td>完成运行手册，或回退配置</td> <td>操作指导已过时</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>另一位负责人更改范围</strong></td> <td>返回 <code>Review</code></td> <td>固定批准描述的是另一份正文</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>写入结果未知</strong></td> <td>先读取目标</td> <td>重试取决于观察到的状态</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>发布者失去访问权限</strong></td> <td>保持 <code>Hold</code> 并申请获授权的管理支持</td> <td>旧授权不允许新的写入</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>**根据当前状态和负责人决定选择。**继续完成需要当前批准和有效控制。补偿需要结合期间发生的编辑评审恢复方案。恢复变更是另一次发布，不是流程的特权例外。</p> <h2 id="发布完成检查"> <a href="#%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83%e5%ae%8c%e6%88%90%e6%a3%80%e6%9f%a5" title="发布完成检查">发布完成检查</a> <a href="#%e5%8f%91%e5%b8%83%e5%ae%8c%e6%88%90%e6%a3%80%e6%9f%a5" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="发布完成检查">#</a> </h2> <p>**交付一份独立评审者能够核对的资料包。**评审者应能找到确切的已评审提案、来源基线、两种角色的评审、每项写入结果、最终值和剩余运行时限制。请他们找出中断后的第一个未完成步骤。</p> <p>**预期判断：**下一步取决于最新来源和台账，而不是先前助手的信心。将最终映射引用带入检索测试，确保发现流程保留相同的权威区分。</p> <h2 id="故障排查与恢复"> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e6%9f%a5%e4%b8%8e%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d" title="故障排查与恢复">故障排查与恢复</a> <a href="#%e6%95%85%e9%9a%9c%e6%8e%92%e6%9f%a5%e4%b8%8e%e6%81%a2%e5%a4%8d" 比较，并执行负责人评审过的恢复或补偿性编辑。记录结果版本，不要假设恢复会重置编号。如果产品选择回退，通过受保护的 PR 回退配置。已删除文件不在回退承诺范围内。</p> <h2 id="练习与自查"> <a href="#%e7%bb%83%e4%b9%a0%e4%b8%8e%e8%87%aa%e6%9f%a5" title="练习与自查">练习与自查</a> <a item.title: Which AI Models Can Run on a Raspberry Pi 4 or 5?
item.category: "Raspberry Pi" , "Artificial Intelligence" , "Self Hosting"
item.description: Use measured Raspberry Pi 4 and 5 results to choose local language models by memory, speed, and workload, from tiny LFM2.5 models to 3B and larger options.
item.content:encoded: <p>A Raspberry Pi can run a useful language model locally, but the model must fit the board’s memory and the response time your application can tolerate. A 2 GB Raspberry Pi 4 is best suited to models below about one billion parameters. An 8 GB Raspberry Pi 5 can run compact 1B–3B models comfortably and load some larger quantized models with substantial compromises.</p> <p>We benchmarked these models ourselves through Ollama on a <strong>2 GB Pi 4B</strong> and an <strong>8 GB Pi 5</strong>, both using microSD storage. The runs behind the tables used the same five short assistant prompts, system prompt, fixed seed, and 140-token output cap. We unloaded other models before each run and measured cold-load time, time to first visible token, total reply time, output speed, and peak resident memory. These were single-pass tests of a short-reply workload, so the results are sizing examples rather than universal speed or answer-quality rankings. The Pi 5’s <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="Cortex-A76 CPU and available memory configurations"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-5/"> <a href="https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-5/" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >Cortex-A76 CPU and available memory configurations</a> </span> also differ materially from the Pi 4’s <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="Cortex-A72 platform"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://pip-assets.raspberrypi.com/categories/545-raspberry-pi-4-model-b/documents/RP-008341-DS-1-raspberry-pi-4-datasheet.pdf"> <a href="https://pip-assets.raspberrypi.com/categories/545-raspberry-pi-4-model-b/documents/RP-008341-DS-1-raspberry-pi-4-datasheet.pdf" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >Cortex-A72 platform</a> </span> .</p> <h2 id="the-model-types-that-make-sense"> <a href="#the-model-types-that-make-sense" title="The model types that make sense">The model types that make sense</a> <a href="#the-model-types-that-make-sense" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="The model types that make sense">#</a> </h2> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Kind of model</th> <th>Examples from the measurements</th> <th>Practical use</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>Tiny text models, about 230M–600M parameters</td> <td>LFM2.5-230M, LFM2.5-350M, Qwen2.5-0.5B</td> <td>Short local commands, summaries, and constrained question answering; the best starting point for a 2 GB Pi 4</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Compact text models, about 1B–2B</td> <td>LFM2.5-1.2B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, Gemma 3 1B, MiniCPM5-1B</td> <td>More room for nuanced instructions on a Pi 5 or a higher-memory Pi 4, with slower replies than the tiniest models</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Quantized 3B–4B text models</td> <td>Qwen2.5-3B, Llama 3.2 3B, Gemma 3 4B</td> <td>More capable candidates for an 8 GB Pi 5 when a wait of several seconds per reply is acceptable</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Larger sparse or hybrid models</td> <td>LFM2.5 8B</td> <td>Technically runnable on the tested 8 GB Pi 5, but with a large memory footprint and long cold load</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>These are <strong>text-generation</strong> results. They do not establish performance for image generation, speech recognition, vision, or training. “Runs” also means more than fitting the model file on a card: the runtime, context cache, operating system, and other services need RAM. Quantization reduces the weight file size, but it can reduce answer quality, especially at extreme settings such as 1-bit weights.</p> <h3 id="what-our-numbers-measure"> <a href="#what-our-numbers-measure" title="What our numbers measure">What our numbers measure</a> <a href="#what-our-numbers-measure" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="What our numbers measure">#</a> </h3> <p>The benchmark sent short factual, procedural safety, retrieved-context, weather, and help prompts to Ollama’s chat API. Each model saw the same prompt set and seed. Before timing a model, we unloaded it so the next request would include a cold load; the reported <strong>wall time</strong> is the complete request, while <strong>tokens per second</strong> describes only output generation. We also recorded the first <em>visible</em> token, which matters when a model spends time reasoning before it answers.</p> <p>For memory, we sampled the Pi’s available RAM and swap alongside the resident memory of Ollama and its inference process during each request. The <strong>RSS</strong> figures below are process-resident memory, not the entire host’s memory demand. File-backed pages, the operating system, a browser, or another local service can still make a nominally fitting model swap. The tables use the original five-prompt, single-pass runs. We later extended the harness with a news prompt and reply-rule checks; those checks clarify what to look for, but they do not turn the earlier timings into six-prompt compliance results.</p> <p>Neither tokens per second nor parameter count is a quality score. A model can emit text quickly yet omit a requested source, exceed a word budget, or produce an unfinished sentence. We would compare models on the prompts we actually plan to send, then inspect their answers before choosing one for an application.</p> <h2 id="raspberry-pi-4-favor-the-smallest-models"> <a href="#raspberry-pi-4-favor-the-smallest-models" title="Raspberry Pi 4: favor the smallest models">Raspberry Pi 4: favor the smallest models</a> <a href="#raspberry-pi-4-favor-the-smallest-models" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="Raspberry Pi 4: favor the smallest models">#</a> </h2> <p>The tested 2 GB Pi 4 had limited headroom. The smallest LFM2.5 models completed all five prompts, as did <code>qwen2.5:0.5b</code>. They are sensible choices for brief offline replies or a small local assistant.</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Model</th> <th style="text-align: right">Model file</th> <th style="text-align: right">Measured output speed</th> <th style="text-align: right">Average reply time</th> <th>Observed memory or outcome</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>LFM2.5-230M, imported GGUF</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.25 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">12.8 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">7.2 s</td> <td>383 MB peak resident memory; 5/5 prompts</td> </tr> <tr> <td>LFM2.5-350M, imported GGUF</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.38 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">8.6 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">8.6 s</td> <td>516 MB peak resident memory; 5/5 prompts</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen2.5:0.5b</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.40 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">8.0 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">9.7 s</td> <td>5/5 prompts; available directly in Ollama</td> </tr> <tr> <td>MiniCPM5-1B, imported GGUF, reasoning off</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.69 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.9 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">12.2 s</td> <td>883 MB peak resident memory; 5/5 prompts</td> </tr> <tr> <td>MiniCPM5-1B, imported GGUF, default reasoning</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.69 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.7 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">33.3 s</td> <td>Only 1/5 prompts returned a useful visible reply</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen3:0.6b</code>, default reasoning</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.52 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">6.4 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">40.4 s</td> <td>One empty reply; board rebooted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>granite4:350m</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.71 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">4.6 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">15.5 s</td> <td>913 MB RSS, no swap or reboot; slow but stable</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>gemma3:1b</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.82 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">4.0 tokens/s</td> <td style="text-align: right">30.7 s</td> <td>Heavy swapping; board rebooted during testing</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen3.5:0.8b</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">1.04 GB</td> <td style="text-align: right">—</td> <td style="text-align: right">—</td> <td>Did not complete; board rebooted</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>The Pi 4 results are especially sensitive to the rest of the system. We observed board resets during larger-model tests, including a <code>qwen3.5:0.8b</code> run that never completed. That is evidence about our 2 GB setup, rather than a claim that every Pi 4 or every 1B model will reboot. A 4 GB or 8 GB Pi 4 has more memory, but its CPU will still make inference slower than on the tested Pi 5. We did not directly benchmark those Pi 4 memory variants.</p> <p>One early Pi 4 pass also appeared much worse than the final measurements: roughly 625 MB of staged GGUF files sat in a RAM-backed <code>/tmp</code>, leaving only about 500–600 MB free and pushing hundreds of megabytes into swap. After moving those files to persistent storage, the small-model results above gave a more useful picture of inference memory. On a 2 GB board, even the <em>location of a download</em> can distort a benchmark.</p> <p><strong>Recommendation:</strong> The imported LFM2.5-350M is our default for this 2 GB board. It remained stable at <strong>516 MB RSS</strong>, left about <strong>1 GB of RAM available</strong>, and passed <strong>5/6</strong> reply-rule checks in the Pi 4 compliance pass. It did miss source names in repeated Pi 5 testing, so applications that require attribution should check for it. Choose LFM2.5-230M when latency and memory headroom matter most: it was faster and lighter, but in one medical-context answer it garbled “nausea or vomiting” into “nausea/ventilator use.” That content error makes it a weaker default for safety or health replies despite its higher repeated mechanical compliance score. Choose <code>qwen2.5:0.5b</code> if you need a model from the <span itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/WebPage"> <meta itemprop="name" content="Ollama registry"> <meta itemprop="url" content="https://ollama.com/library/qwen2.5/tags"> <a href="https://ollama.com/library/qwen2.5/tags" rel="noopener external" target="_blank" >Ollama registry</a> </span> , while accounting for its weaker instruction compliance. <code>granite4:350m</code> stayed stable but took longer and used more memory; MiniCPM5-1B is viable only when the client disables reasoning. Avoid Gemma 3 1B and Qwen3.5 0.8B on this specific 2 GB setup because our runs triggered resets.</p> <h2 id="raspberry-pi-5-more-choice-with-a-speed-tradeoff"> <a href="#raspberry-pi-5-more-choice-with-a-speed-tradeoff" title="Raspberry Pi 5: more choice, with a speed tradeoff">Raspberry Pi 5: more choice, with a speed tradeoff</a> <a href="#raspberry-pi-5-more-choice-with-a-speed-tradeoff" class="h-anchor" aria-hidden="true" title="Raspberry Pi 5: more choice, with a speed tradeoff">#</a> </h2> <p>The 8 GB Pi 5 handled all <strong>25 models</strong> in our speed-and-memory benchmark. The table includes every run, including models we do not recommend for this short-reply workload. A dagger marks an imported GGUF. “Think off” records the setting used for the speed run; the separate compliance pass did not necessarily use that setting.</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Model</th> <th style="text-align: right">File GB</th> <th style="text-align: right">Output tok/s</th> <th style="text-align: right">Reply s</th> <th style="text-align: right">Peak RSS MB</th> <th>Short-reply assessment</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><code>lfm2.5-230m</code> †</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.25</td> <td style="text-align: right">45.0</td> <td style="text-align: right">1.8</td> <td style="text-align: right">446</td> <td>Lowest latency; 78% repeated compliance</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>bonsai-1.7b</code> †, Q1_0</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.25</td> <td style="text-align: right">15.3</td> <td style="text-align: right">8.2</td> <td style="text-align: right">871</td> <td>Skip: 1-bit weights and 3/6 single-pass compliance</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>lfm2.5-350m</code> †</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.38</td> <td style="text-align: right">30.0</td> <td style="text-align: right">2.1</td> <td style="text-align: right">581</td> <td>Fast, but missed source citation in 5/18 repeats</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen2.5:0.5b</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.40</td> <td style="text-align: right">28.4</td> <td style="text-align: right">3.6</td> <td style="text-align: right">675</td> <td>Easy registry option; 61% repeated compliance</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen3:0.6b</code>, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.52</td> <td style="text-align: right">23.0</td> <td style="text-align: right">4.3</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,069</td> <td>Conditional: 4/6 compliance pass, reasoning setting matters</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>bonsai-4b</code> †, Q1_0</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.57</td> <td style="text-align: right">6.8</td> <td style="text-align: right">18.1</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,343</td> <td>Experimental 1-bit model; 6/6 single pass is unconfirmed</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>minicpm5-1b</code> †, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.69</td> <td style="text-align: right">18.4</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.1</td> <td style="text-align: right">869</td> <td>Conditional: default reasoning gave empty replies</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>granite4:350m</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.71</td> <td style="text-align: right">12.1</td> <td style="text-align: right">6.6</td> <td style="text-align: right">892</td> <td>Fits, but slower and larger than small LFM2.5</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>lfm2.5-1.2b</code> †</td> <td style="text-align: right">0.73</td> <td style="text-align: right">15.5</td> <td style="text-align: right">4.7</td> <td style="text-align: right">967</td> <td>Best overall for our workload; 89% repeated compliance</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>llama3.2:1b-instruct-q4_K_M</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.81</td> <td style="text-align: right">13.0</td> <td style="text-align: right">7.5</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,244</td> <td>Registry alternative; 5/6 compliance pass</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>gemma3:1b</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.82</td> <td style="text-align: right">11.2</td> <td style="text-align: right">10.9</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,262</td> <td>Best registry-only repeated compliance: 83%</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">0.99</td> <td style="text-align: right">10.3</td> <td style="text-align: right">9.4</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,361</td> <td>4/6 compliance pass; Gemma 3 1B followed rules better</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen3.5:0.8b</code>, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">1.04</td> <td style="text-align: right">8.8</td> <td style="text-align: right">12.2</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,592</td> <td>0/6 with default reasoning; avoid without thinking control</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>spark-x2.5-1.7b</code> †, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">1.11</td> <td style="text-align: right">9.7</td> <td style="text-align: right">9.4</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,542</td> <td>0/6 with default reasoning; avoid without thinking control</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen3:1.7b</code>, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">1.36</td> <td style="text-align: right">8.1</td> <td style="text-align: right">12.4</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,867</td> <td>Conditional; more memory and delay than smaller choices</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>minicpm5-2b</code> †, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">1.56</td> <td style="text-align: right">7.7</td> <td style="text-align: right">10.9</td> <td style="text-align: right">1,787</td> <td>Conditional; 5/6 single pass, extra bullets</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">1.93</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.2</td> <td style="text-align: right">14.7</td> <td style="text-align: right">2,366</td> <td>Trial 3B option; 5/6 single pass</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>granite4:micro-h</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">1.94</td> <td style="text-align: right">3.9</td> <td style="text-align: right">23.7</td> <td style="text-align: right">2,486</td> <td>Skip for interactive use: slow decode</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>llama3.2:3b-instruct-q4_K_M</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">2.02</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.5</td> <td style="text-align: right">18.6</td> <td style="text-align: right">2,831</td> <td>Alternative 3B trial; no compliance run reported</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>granite4:micro</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">2.10</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.3</td> <td style="text-align: right">17.9</td> <td style="text-align: right">2,679</td> <td>Fits, but slower replies than smaller alternatives</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>qwen3.5:2b</code>, think off</td> <td style="text-align: right">2.74</td> <td style="text-align: right">5.0</td> <td style="text-align: right">16.1</td> <td style="text-align: right">3,627</td> <td>High memory and delay; no compliance run reported</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>gemma3:4b</code></td> <td style="text-align: right">3.34</td> <td style="text-align: right">3.9</td> <td style="text-align: right">30.3</td> <td style="text-align: right">4,267</td> <td>Skip for responsive replies;
